name: TrustDemoIND01
title: TD.IND.01 Foreign doses imported as verified
description: Of the foreign DVCs a clinic scans to verify, the proportion whose dose is recorded as verified.
guidance: A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: TD.J3A.DE02 Issuing country; TD.J3A.DE03 Verified at; TD.J3A.DE05 Verification result; TD.J3A.DE07 Failure reason; TD.J3A.DE09 Record outcome. Decision tables: TD.DT.01. Requirements: STT-VER-001, STT-VER-006, STT-VER-008. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.

population.description: Foreign DVCs scanned for verification in the reporting period.

criteria.expression: COUNT of verification records (TD.J3A) WHERE "Verified at" is in the reporting period

population.description: Foreign DVCs scanned for verification in the reporting period whose dose was recorded as verified.

criteria.expression: COUNT of verification records (TD.J3A) WHERE "Verified at" is in the reporting period AND "Record outcome" = verified

stratifier.description: the STT-VER-008 reason, for DVCs that did not verify
the participant that signed the DVC
